run_ordering_benchmark: run the surya layout reading order benchmark with default results directory and all training images
run_ordering_benchmark_max_rows: run the surya layout reading order benchmark on a subset of 100 images from the training split
run_ordering_benchmark_custom_dir: run the surya layout reading order benchmark and save results to a custom output directory
test_ordering_benchmark: test the ordering benchmark CLI module with max_rows set to 50
review_ordering_benchmark: review the surya layout reading order benchmark script and its accuracy metrics
